## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `amp-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Create or select a project in OpenChoreo

1. <!-- manual: Log in to the WSO2 OpenChoreo console. -->
2. In the left navigation, select **Projects**.
3. Select **Create Project**, fill in the project name and description, then select **Save**.
4. <!-- manual: Select Create Project, fill in the project name and description, then select Save. -->
5. <!-- manual: Open the project details page and note the Project UID — you will need this for projectUid. -->

## Step 3: Create a component

1. Within your project, select **Components** in the left navigation.
2. Select **Create Component** and configure the component name and type (for example, Service or Job).
3. <!-- manual: configure the component name; type (for example -->
4. Select **Save** and open the component details page.
5. <!-- manual: Copy the Component UID — you will need this for componentUid. -->

## Step 4: Obtain your organization UID and environment UID

1. Select your organization name in the top-right corner and select **Settings**.
2. <!-- manual: Under Organization Details, copy the Organization UID — this is your orgUid. -->
3. Return to your project, select **Environments** in the left navigation, select the target environment, and copy its **Environment UID** — this is your `environmentUid`.
4. <!-- manual: copy its Environment UID — this is your environmentUid -->

## Step 5: Generate an API key

1. <!-- manual: In the OpenChoreo console, navigate to Settings › API Keys. -->
2. Select **Generate API Key**, assign a descriptive name (for example, `amp-tracing-key`), and select the observability scope.
3. Select **Generate** and copy the API key value immediately — it is shown only once.

## Step 6: Locate the OpenTelemetry endpoint

1. <!-- manual: In the OpenChoreo console, navigate to Settings › Observability or Endpoints. -->
2. <!-- manual: Copy the OTLP HTTP base URL — this is your otelEndpoint. For local or development AMP deployments the default is http://localhost:22893/otel. -->
